description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Connection Technology Center (CTC) designs and manufactures vibration analysis hardware for machine condition monitoring. The Full Stack Developer I develops and maintains internal and customer-facing web applications, spanning user interfaces, server-side logic, APIs, and databases.
Full Stack Developer I building web applications spanning UI, REST APIs, and databases for industrial workflows

Responsibilities:
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Implement modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue) to create interactive user experiences
• Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure seamless integration of design elements
• Design and implement server-side logic using server-side languages (e.g., Python, C#)
• Build and maintain databases, ensuring optimal performance and data integrity
• Develop RESTful APIs to facilitate communication between front-end and back-end systems
• Design and implement database schemas, queries, and optimizations
• Ensure data security, integrity, and scalability in database management
• Conduct thorough testing of applications, identifying and resolving bugs and performance issues
• Reviews code prior to deployment
• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including graphic designers, product managers, and other developers
• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide project updates
• Internal web applications supporting manufacturing, calibration, and operational workflows
• Customer-facing portals and dashboards used by engineers and industrial clients
• Full-stack features spanning UI, APIs, and databases
• Enhancements and modernization of existing applications

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree and 0-2 years of relevant work experience
• Experience with Search Engine Optimization
• Experience with jQuery, Angular and/or React
• Basic proficiency in all required languages
• Basic proficiency with web development
• Ability to complete projects with mentorship from senior development staff
• Ability to debug issues with assistance from mentors
• Knowledge of the Microsoft.NET framework and C# programming
• Proficiency with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and ASP.NET
• Ability to use and implement MSSQL and/or MySQL database
• Understanding of REST APIs
• Must be able to work individually as well as in a small team environment
